title: Hosts overview
description: arnor and gondor, sampled over SSH every 5 minutes by gadget-monitor.

panels.title: Check status
panels.description: Did each check run and exit successfully? FAIL covers errors, timeouts, skipped (still stuck from last run), and host unreachable. See 'Collector internals' for the reason.

panels.title: SSH session
panels.description: Whether the collector's persistent SSH session (and remote agent) is up.

panels.title: Last backup
panels.description: Age of the newest complete backup on /service/shire. Hourly should stay under ~1h; daily under ~1d.

panels.title: Storage
panels.description: Local database (limit 4.5 GiB; backups refuse above it) and total backup size on shire (hard budget 10 GB).

panels.title: CPU utilization
panels.description: Average busy % across all cores (everything except idle and iowait), averaged over each sample interval.

panels.title: Load average
panels.description: 1-minute (solid) and 5-minute (dashed) load averages. Compare with core counts: arnor 256, gondor 128.

panels.title: Load per core
panels.description: Load average divided by online CPUs; around 1.0 means every core has work queued.

panels.title: Memory available
panels.description: Available (solid) is how much memory new work can still use, counting cache the kernel would give back. Total (dashed) is installed RAM.

panels.title: Swap free
panels.description: Free swap (solid) against total swap (dashed). gondor has no swap configured, so both are 0.

panels.title: Swap free now
panels.description: Percent of swap still free. 'no swap' means the host has none configured.

panels.title: Login time
panels.description: Time for a brand-new interactive SSH login to reach a usable shell, probed every 5 minutes (every 15 after repeated timeouts). Timeouts (60 s) show as FAIL on ssh_login in Check status.

panels.title: Login stages: $host
panels.description: Where the login time goes, stacked. connect: DNS and TCP. auth: key exchange and authentication, which on these hosts reads ~/.ssh/authorized_keys from the NFS home directory. shell: session setup, login shell and profile until a typed command runs. A hung login shows only the stages it finished.

panels.title: Queue wait per call: helios
panels.description: Average time an NFS call to helios waited in the client before being sent, over all operations, from the kernel's per-mount counters. Rising queue wait means the client has more requests than it can put on the wire (or the server is slow to free slots).

targets.expr: sum by (host) (rate(gadget_nfs_queue_seconds_total{host=~"$host", fs="helios"}[$__interval])) / sum by (host) (rate(gadget_nfs_ops_total{host=~"$host", fs="helios"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Round-trip time per call: helios
panels.description: Average time from sending an NFS call to helios until its reply arrived (network plus server), over all operations. Calls still in progress are not counted until they finish, so a hung server shows as a gap, not a spike.

targets.expr: sum by (host) (rate(gadget_nfs_rtt_seconds_total{host=~"$host", fs="helios"}[$__interval])) / sum by (host) (rate(gadget_nfs_ops_total{host=~"$host", fs="helios"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Queue wait by operation: $host, helios
panels.description: Average client-side queue wait per call to helios, per NFS operation. OPEN includes OPEN_NOATTR; OTHER is every remaining operation (DELEGRETURN, SETATTR, RENAME, READDIR, LOCK, COMMIT, ...). A line has gaps while that operation had no calls.

targets.expr: sum by (op) (rate(gadget_nfs_queue_seconds_total{host="$host", fs="helios"}[$__interval])) / sum by (op) (rate(gadget_nfs_ops_total{host="$host", fs="helios"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Check duration
panels.description: Wall time of each check on the target.

panels.title: Check outcome by reason
panels.description: Number of checks per host in each non-OK state: error, timeout, skipped_running (previous run still stuck), unreachable (no session), lost (session died mid-check).

panels.title: Clock skew
panels.description: Target clock minus collector clock, from ping round trips. Check timestamps use the target's clock.

panels.title: SSH reconnects
panels.description: Session drops per hour. Should be 0 in normal operation.

panels.title: Lines dropped
panels.description: Malformed or excess (>500) output lines discarded by the collector. Empty is good.
